translations.text: The Most Merciful
Taught the Qur'an,
Created man,
[And] taught him eloquence.
The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
And the stars and trees prostrate.
And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
That you not transgress within the balance.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
verses.transliteration: Wa aqeemul wazna bilqisti wa laa tukhsirul meezaan

translations.text: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.

verses.transliteration: Feehaa faakihatunw wan nakhlu zaatul akmaam

translations.text: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
And grain having husks and scented plants.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.

verses.text_uthmani: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍۢ مِّن نَّارٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa khalaqal jaaan mim maarijim min naar

translations.text: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
[He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
He released the two seas, meeting [side by side];
Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.transliteration: Yakhruju minhumal lu 'lu u wal marjaanu

translations.text: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ
verses.transliteration: Wa lahul jawaaril mun sha'aatu fil bahri kal a'laam

translations.text: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
Everyone upon the earth will perish,

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
verses.transliteration: Wa yabqaa wajhu rabbika zul jalaali wal ikraam

translations.text: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Yas'aluhoo man fissamaawaati walard; kulla ywmin huwa fee shaan

translations.text: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
We will attend to you, O prominent beings.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text_uthmani: يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Yaa ma'sharal jinni wal insi inis tata'tum an tanfuzoo min aqtaaris samaawaati wal ardi fanfuzoo; laa tanfuzoona illaa bisultaan

translations.text: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah].
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text_uthmani: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌۭ مِّن نَّارٍۢ وَنُحَاسٌۭ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
verses.transliteration: Yursalu 'alaikumaa shuwaazum min naarifiw-wa nuhaasun falaa tantasiraan

translations.text: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةًۭ كَٱلدِّهَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fa-izan shaqqatis samaaa'u fakaanat wardatan kaddihaan

translations.text: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

verses.text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌۭ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
verses.transliteration: Fa-yawma'izil laa yus'alu 'an zambiheee insunw wa laa jaann

translations.text: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text_uthmani: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
verses.transliteration: Yu'raful mujrimoona biseemaahum fa'yu'khazu binna waasi wal aqdaam

translations.text: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text_uthmani: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Haazihee jahannamul latee yukazzibu bihal mujrimoon

translations.text: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.

verses.transliteration: Yatoofoona bainahaa wa baina hameemim aan

translations.text: They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.transliteration: Wa liman khaafa maqaama rabbihee jannataan

translations.text: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
Having [spreading] branches.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
In both of them are two springs, flowing.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text_uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Muttaki'eena 'alaa furushim bataaa'inuhaa min istabraq; wajanal jannataini daan

translations.text: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text_uthmani: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
verses.transliteration: Feehinna qaasiratut tarfi lam yatmishunna insun qablahum wa laa jaaann

translations.text: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinni -
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
As if they were rubies and coral.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
Is the reward for good [anything] but good?
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
Dark green [in color].
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
In both of them are two springs, spouting.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.transliteration: Feehimaa faakihatunw wa nakhlunw wa rummaan

translations.text: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
In them are good and beautiful women -
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
Fair ones reserved in pavilions -
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

verses.text_uthmani: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
verses.transliteration: Lam yatmis hunna insun qablahum wa laa jaaann

translations.text: Untouched before them by man or jinni -
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

verses.text_uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍۢ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍۢ

translations.text: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

verses.text_uthmani: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ

translations.text: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
